# **Reporting Security Issues**

The project's team and community take security issues seriously.

We appreciate your efforts to disclose your findings responsibly and will make every effort to acknowledge your contributions.

To report a security issue, create a new GitHub issue using the 🐛 Bug Report template.

If your report could leak data or might expose how to gain access to a restricted area or break the system, please email [Yumeio0308@gmail.com](mailto:Yumeio0308@gmail.com) and include "SECURITY" in the subject line.

We'll endeavour to respond quickly and keep you updated throughout the process.
